# Migrations changes newer than the docs snapshot

github/docs does not carry the GitHub Changelog. The bundled `references/` tree is a snapshot (see `upstream_committed_at` in `references/SOURCE.json`), and features often ship, change status or get renamed before the docs catch up.

This list covers 2025-11-23 to 2026-11-23. Where an entry and the docs disagree, the newer dated source wins; say which one you used and read the linked entry for scope and limits before relying on it. For anything after 2026-11-23, check the label feeds:

- https://github.blog/changelog/label/enterprise-management-tools/feed/

Older entries are on `?paged=2`, `?paged=3` and so on.

|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-19 | New | [Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-19-enterprise-live-migrations-from-azure-devops-generally-available) |
| 2026-09-01 | New | [Enterprise Live Migrations from GHES to ghe.com generally available](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-enterprise-live-migrations-from-ghes-to-ghe-com-generally-available) |
| 2026-08-03 | New | [Migrate from GitLab to GitHub with GitHub Enterprise Importer](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-08-03-migrate-from-gitlab-to-github-with-github-enterprise-importer) |
